summary: Intent Design adds a read-only Intent Graph Visual Explorer that progressively discloses intent views from the SystemArchitecture top level, derives view hierarchy from mounted subdiagram views on included elements, and supports search-driven expansion by view name or included element name.

explicitTestcases.name: INTENT-GRAPH-TOP-LEVEL-DRILLDOWN
explicitTestcases.controlPoint: Open the read-only intent graph visual explorer against design/KG/SystemArchitecture.json, observe the initial render, then click a top-level view and continue drilling into one of its child views.
explicitTestcases.observationPoint: The initial render shows only the first-layer child views under SystemArchitecture, and each click expands only the selected path to the next mounted child view instead of expanding the full tree.
explicitTestcases.acceptanceBoundary: Freeze the read-only browsing contract, top-level-only initial disclosure, and click-driven progressive expansion where parent-child view hierarchy is derived from subdiagram views mounted on elements included by the parent view; do not require editing, persistence, or full-tree eager expansion.
explicitTestcases.implementationNotes: Implementation Design must materialize a single executable explicit testcase entry without rewriting the acceptance boundary defined on element 1390.

explicitTestcases.name: INTENT-GRAPH-SEARCH-EXPANSION
explicitTestcases.controlPoint: Open the read-only intent graph visual explorer and search by either a view name or an element name that is included by a target view.
explicitTestcases.observationPoint: The UI reveals at least one matching target view and expands the visible ancestor path to that view; if the same child view is reachable through multiple expanded parent branches, repeated appearances are allowed.
explicitTestcases.acceptanceBoundary: Freeze search-driven expansion over view names and included element names, plus visible-path reveal toward the matched view; treat MINDMAP style as a disclosure reference rather than a pixel-perfect rendering contract.
explicitTestcases.implementationNotes: Implementation Design must preserve the minimum search scope of view names plus included element names and keep the testcase read-only with respect to the intent graph file.

frozenBaselines: Version 1 is a read-only intent graph browser; it does not edit or write back design/KG/SystemArchitecture.json.
The default initial render is limited to the first-layer child views under the SystemArchitecture view.
View expansion is progressive and user-driven; clicking expands only the selected path rather than the full graph.
A child view is considered downstream of a parent view when the parent view includes an element that mounts the child as a subdiagram view.
Search must cover at least view names and names of elements included by a view.
The same child view may appear under multiple parent branches when multiple expanded parent views include the mounting element.
MINDMAP is a presentation reference for progressive disclosure, not a pixel-perfect acceptance baseline.
notes: Repository evidence at Intent Design time shows src/visualIntentGraphEditor/ exists but is currently empty and has no stable architecture contract yet.
The new intent view for this feature is view 176, mounted under element 1390 and tracing relationships 1212, 1213, 1214, and 1215.
